# WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted { #wass2s.WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted }

```python
WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted(
    distribution='gaussian',
    cv_method=None,
    rolling_window_size=15,
    n_samples_for_chisq='total_ensemble',
    eps_lognormal=0.01,
    sigma_floor=1e-12,
)
```

Min et al. (2009) Probability-Weighted Multi-Model Ensemble (PMME).

## What this class does {.doc-section .doc-section-what-this-class-does}

1) For each model compute tercile probabilities (PB / PN / PA) at every
   grid point from its ensemble forecast using one of three distributions:

   * 'gaussian'  : Gaussian approximation.
                   Boundaries  : T_lo/hi = mu_hcst ± 0.4307 * sigma_hcst
                   Probability : Phi( (T_lo/hi - f_mean) / sigma_FORECAST )
                   sigma_FORECAST = std of the current forecast ensemble.

   * 'lognormal' : Same logic in log-space (better for precipitation).
                   eps_lognormal is added before taking logs.

   * 'empirical' : Category boundaries are the hindcast q33/q66.
                   Probability = fraction of forecast ensemble members
                   below q33 / above q66.

2) Combine per-model probabilities with weights w_m ∝ sqrt(N_m) (Min 2009
   eq. 1), normalised to sum to 1.

3) Optionally compute a combined categorical map with a chi-square
   significance test (Min 2009 section 3b, df = 2).

## Assumed dims {.doc-section .doc-section-assumed-dims}

forecasts[m] : at minimum dim 'M' (ensemble members); spatial dims optional.
hindcasts[m] : dims 'T' (years) and 'M' (members); same spatial dims.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                | Type                                                         | Description                                                                                                                | Default            |
|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| distribution        | gaussian \| lognormal \| empirical                           |                                                                                                                            | `'gaussian'`       |
| cv_method           | Optional\[Literal\[\'leave_one_out\', \'rolling_window\'\]\] | How to compute climatological mu / sigma from the hindcast pool. None -> use the full hindcast pool (no cross-validation). | `None`             |
| rolling_window_size | int                                                          | Half-width of the rolling window when cv_method='rolling_window'.                                                          | `15`               |
| n_samples_for_chisq | total_ensemble \| effective_sample_size \| float             | How to compute N for the chi-square test.                                                                                  | `'total_ensemble'` |
| eps_lognormal       | float                                                        | Small offset added before log transform (lognormal path only).                                                             | `0.01`             |
| sigma_floor         | float                                                        | Any sigma <= this value is replaced by the full-hindcast raw sigma.                                                        | `1e-12`            |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [compute_combined_map](#wass2s.WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_combined_map) | Combined categorical map with chi-square significance test. |
| [compute_pmme_probabilities](#wass2s.WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_pmme_probabilities) | Compute PMME probabilities (PB / PN / PA) across models. |

### compute_combined_map { #wass2s.WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_combined_map }

```python
WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_combined_map(
    pmme_probs,
    ensemble_sizes,
    model_names,
    significance_level=0.05,
)
```

Combined categorical map with chi-square significance test.
[Min 2009, section 3b]

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name         | Type      | Description                                                                                                 |
|--------------|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| combined_map | DataArray | 0 = no significant deviation from equal probabilities, 1 = PB dominant,  2 = PN dominant,  3 = PA dominant. |
| chi_square   | DataArray | chi-square statistic (df = 2).                                                                              |

### compute_pmme_probabilities { #wass2s.WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_pmme_probabilities }

```python
WAS_Min2009_ProbWeighted.compute_pmme_probabilities(
    forecasts,
    hindcasts,
    climatology=None,
    ensemble_sizes=None,
    strict_models=True,
)
```

Compute PMME probabilities (PB / PN / PA) across models.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                      | Description   | Default           |
|----------------|---------------------------|---------------|-------------------|
| forecasts      | Dict\[str, xr.DataArray\] |               | _required_        |
| hindcasts      | Dict\[str, xr.DataArray\] |               | _required_        |
| climatology    | Optional\[xr.DataArray\]  |               | `None`            |
| ensemble_sizes | model_name: int           |               | `model_name: int` |
| strict_models  | bool                      | same keys.    | `True`            |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                         | Description   |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
|        | dict with keys \'PB\', \'PN\', \'PA\'  (each a DataArray over spatial dims). |               |
